title: Write a complete getting started
body:
The getting started is intended for new comers. They should have some basic knowledge of React and some general ideas of Algolia. The getting started is the main door to the rest of the documentation, it is not the full documentation so it doesn't have to cover everything (just the basic so that the user can do it by himself, based on his requirements)

Subjects to cover in the getting started:
- concept of the main wrapper
- configuration of the wrapper
- concept of widgets
- usage of some basic widgets (searchbox, hits, a filter?)
- pointers to the guides to learn more about a subject that is not covered by the getting started
